text:
Which statement about acids is correct?
A
Acids are proton acceptors.
B
Acids transfer electrons to bases in aqueous solution.
C
Hydrochloric acid reacts with ammonium hydroxide to produce ammonia.
D
Ethanoic acid partially ionises in aqueous solution.

options.label: B
options.text: Acids transfer electrons to bases in aqueous solution.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrochloric acid reacts with ammonium hydroxide to produce ammonia.

options.label: D
options.text: Ethanoic acid partially ionises in aqueous solution.
